At "Aoji Sh谷" (青ジシ谷), a satoyama (foothill village) environment being restored, we grow rice by reviving abandoned paddies.

【Fee】Adults ¥3,000 | Students ¥2,000 | Preschool children ¥1,500 (includes guide, insurance, and tools)

【Capacity】15 people

【Guide】Mori no Field School staff

【What to bring】Drinks, lunch, work gloves, towel, hat, change of clothes, rubber boots

【More info】Mori no Field School website: https://morinomanabiya168.wixsite.com/website
